research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Volta Labs is focused on enhancing genetic engineering automation through innovative fluid manipulation technologies. They are developing methods for biological assays using electrowetting on dielectric (EWOD) to process samples with precision. Their research includes magnetic bead-assisted separation, leveraging magnetic fields for artifact responsiveness. Surface coatings are also being explored to improve fluid movement reliability and accuracy. Additionally, they are investigating the use of electrode pads to control liquid droplet motion, aiming for smoother and more efficient operations. Volta Labs' R&D efforts are concentrated on refining droplet manipulation for more scalable genetic engineering solutions.

press_references.value: Volta Labs Delivers the Ultimate Whole Genome Sequencing Sample Prep Launch: Callisto™ Now Unifies the Entire WGS Ecosystem on One Platform

product_launches.description: Volta Labs launched seven validated whole‑genome sequencing DNA Apps on its Callisto platform, enabling fully automated WGS library prep across Illumina, ONT, PacBio, Element, and Ultima systems with chemistries from NEB, Twist, Qiagen, Watchmaker, and others. about_short_description.short_description: Volta Labs develops scalable automation for genetic engineering.

product.name: Callisto™ Sample Prep System
product.description: A benchtop digital-fluidics instrument that automates nucleic acid extraction, sequencing library preparation, and target enrichment for DNA and RNA workflows.

product.name: VoltaPrep™
product.description: A portfolio of automated sequencing library-preparation workflows and reagent kits for converting purified nucleic acids into libraries for short- and long-read sequencing.

product.name: VoltaPure™
product.description: A family of extraction chemistries and reagent kits for automated purification of nucleic acids from biological samples on the Callisto system.

product.name: VoltaHyb™
product.description: A suite of automated hybridization-capture workflows and kits for enriching targeted sequencing libraries on the Callisto system.

product.name: Double-Sided Size Selection
product.description: An automated size-selection workflow for separating DNA fragments by length during sequencing sample preparation on the Callisto platform.
